description: Final electrostatic surface analysis of the bovine BBSome (6VBV): per-subunit surface potential by face, contiguous charged region attribution, and Fisher test for depletion of BBS9 from the membrane-proximal surface
code:
import os, requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from scipy import ndimage, stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

OUT="/tmp/bbs9f"; os.makedirs(OUT,exist_ok=True)
H={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
AA3to1={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y',
'VAL':'V','MSE':'M','SEC':'U','PYL':'O'}
SUB={"0":"BBS18","1":"BBS1","2":"BBS2","3":"ARL6","4":"BBS4","5":"BBS5","7":"BBS7","8":"BBS8","9":"BBS9"}
def load(pid):
    f=f"{OUT}/{pid}.cif"
    if not os.path.exists(f):
        r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.cif",headers=H,timeout=180); r.raise_for_status()
        open(f,"w").write(r.text)
    cols=[];rows=[];reading=False
    for line in open(f):
        t=line.strip()
        if t.startswith("_atom_site."): cols.append(t.split(".")[1].split()[0]); continue
        if cols and not reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="" or t.startswith("_") or t.startswith("loop_"): continue
            reading=True
        if reading:
            if t.startswith("#") or t=="": break
            pp=t.split()
            if len(pp)==len(cols): rows.append(pp)
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=cols); df=df[df["group_PDB"]=="ATOM"].copy()
    if "label_alt_id" in df: df=df[df["label_alt_id"].isin([".","A"])]
    for c in ["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]: df[c]=pd.to_numeric(df[c],errors="coerce")
    df["resnum"]=pd.to_numeric(df["auth_seq_id"],errors="coerce")
    df["chain"]=df["auth_asym_id"]; df["aa"]=df["label_comp_id"].map(AA3to1)
    df["sub"]=df["chain"].map(lambda c:SUB.get(c,c)); df["atom"]=df["label_atom_id"].str.strip('"')
    return df.dropna(subset=["aa"]).reset_index(drop=True)

df=load("6VBV")
xyz=df[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy(); com=xyz.mean(0)
noarl=df[df["sub"]!="ARL6"][["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy(); ctr=noarl.mean(0)
ccv=noarl-ctr; w,V=np.linalg.eigh(ccv.T@ccv/len(ccv)); nrm=V[:,0]
if (df[df["sub"]=="ARL6"][["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy().mean(0)-ctr)@nrm<0: nrm=-nrm

SP=1.5; lo=xyz.min(0)-5.0; hi=xyz.max(0)+5.0
n=np.ceil((hi-lo)/SP).astype(int)+1
G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(*[lo[k]+np.arange(n[k])*SP for k in range(3)],indexing="ij"),-1).reshape(-1,3)
d1,_=cKDTree(xyz).query(G,k=1); D=d1.reshape(n)
solv=D>=3.0; lab,_=ndimage.label(solv)
edge=set(np.unique(np.concatenate([lab[0].ravel(),lab[-1].ravel(),lab[:,0].ravel(),
        lab[:,-1].ravel(),lab[:,:,0].ravel(),lab[:,:,-1].ravel()])))-{0}
shell=((D>=3.0)&(D<4.5))&np.isin(lab,list(edge))
sidx=np.argwhere(shell); SPTS=lo+sidx*SP

TIP={'D':['OD1','OD2'],'E':['OE1','OE2'],'K':['NZ'],'R':['NH1','NH2','NE']}
QP=[];Q=[]
for (sb,ch,rn),g in df.groupby(["sub","chain","resnum"]):
    aa=g["aa"].iloc[0]
    if aa not in TIP: continue
    t=g[g["atom"].isin(TIP[aa])]
    if len(t)==0: continue
    QP.append(t[["Cartn_x","Cartn_y","Cartn_z"]].to_numpy().mean(0)); Q.append(-1.0 if aa in "DE" else 1.0)
QP=np.array(QP); Q=np.array(Q)
KAPPA=1/7.86; EPS=80.0
phi=np.zeros(len(SPTS))
for i,ix in enumerate(cKDTree(QP).query_ball_point(SPTS,25.0)):
    if not ix: continue
    ix=np.asarray(ix); r=np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(QP[ix]-SPTS[i],axis=1),2.0)
    phi[i]=(332.0/EPS)*np.sum(Q[ix]*np.exp(-KAPPA*r)/r)

_,ai=cKDTree(xyz).query(SPTS,k=1); sp_sub=df["sub"].to_numpy()[ai]
proj_s=(SPTS-ctr)@nrm; thr=np.percentile(proj_s,75); mf=proj_s>=thr
T=pd.DataFrame({"sub":sp_sub,"phi":phi,"memface":mf,"proj":proj_s})

# Fisher test: is BBS9 depleted from the membrane-proximal surface quartile?
print("subunit  prox  dist   OR     95%CI            p(Fisher, two-sided)   mean_phi_prox  mean_phi_dist")
rows=[]
for s in ["BBS1","BBS2","BBS4","BBS5","BBS7","BBS8","BBS9","BBS18"]:
    a=int(((T["sub"]==s)&T.memface).sum()); b=int(((T["sub"]==s)&~T.memface).sum())
    c=int(((T["sub"]!=s)&T.memface).sum()); d=int(((T["sub"]!=s)&~T.memface).sum())
    orr,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
    se=np.sqrt(1/max(a,1)+1/max(b,1)+1/c+1/d); lo95,hi95=np.exp(np.log(orr)-1.96*se),np.exp(np.log(orr)+1.96*se)
    pp=T[(T["sub"]==s)&T.memface]["phi"].mean(); pd_=T[(T["sub"]==s)&~T.memface]["phi"].mean()
    print(f"{s:7s} {a:5d} {b:5d}  {orr:5.3f}  [{lo95:.3f}, {hi95:.3f}]   {p:.3e}      {pp:+.3f}        {pd_:+.3f}")
    rows.append(dict(sub=s,prox=a,dist=b,OR=orr,p=p,phi_prox=pp,phi_dist=pd_))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows)

def regions(sign,qthr,top=5):
    th=np.percentile(phi,qthr); m=(phi<=th) if sign<0 else (phi>=th)
    vol=np.zeros(n,bool); vol[tuple(sidx[m].T)]=True
    lb,nl=ndimage.label(vol,structure=np.ones((3,3,3)))
    sz=ndimage.sum(vol,lb,range(1,nl+1)); order=np.argsort(sz)[::-1]; out=[]
    for k in order[:top]:
        if sz[k]<40: break
        pts=lo+np.argwhere(lb==k+1)*SP
        hit=np.array([len(x)>0 for x in cKDTree(pts).query_ball_point(xyz,5.0)])
        lin=df[hit].groupby(["sub","chain","resnum"]).agg(aa=("aa","first")).reset_index()
        out.append(dict(area=float(sz[k]*SP**2),dcom=float(np.linalg.norm(pts.mean(0)-com)),
                        proj=float((pts.mean(0)-ctr)@nrm),
                        comp=dict(lin.groupby("sub").size().sort_values(ascending=False)),nlin=len(lin)))
    return out
NEG=regions(-1,15); POS=regions(1,85)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(16.5,4.8))
for a,p,t,col in [(ax[0],NEG[0],"Largest negative surface region","#c0392b"),
                  (ax[1],POS[0],"Largest positive surface region","#2c6fbb")]:
    ks=list(p["comp"].keys())
    a.bar(ks,[p["comp"][k] for k in ks],color=["#f39c12" if k=="BBS9" else col for k in ks])
    a.set_title(f"{t}\n{p['area']:.0f} sq A, centre {p['dcom']:.0f} A from COM, "
                f"membrane axis {p['proj']:+.0f} A",fontsize=9)
    a.set_ylabel("lining residues"); a.tick_params(axis="x",rotation=45)
so=["BBS1","BBS2","BBS4","BBS5","BBS7","BBS8","BBS9","BBS18"]
pv=R.set_index("sub").reindex(so); xx=np.arange(len(so)); wd=0.38
ax[2].bar(xx-wd/2,pv["phi_dist"],wd,label="rest of surface",color="#95a5a6")
ax[2].bar(xx+wd/2,pv["phi_prox"],wd,label="membrane-proximal quartile",color="#27ae60")
for i,s in enumerate(so):
    ax[2].annotate(f"OR {pv.loc[s,'OR']:.2f}",(i,max(pv.loc[s,'phi_dist'],pv.loc[s,'phi_prox'])+0.02),
                   ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
ax[2].set_xticks(xx); ax[2].set_xticklabels(so,rotation=45); ax[2].axhline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
ax[2].set_ylabel("mean screened Coulomb potential (kcal/mol/e)")
ax[2].set_title("Surface electrostatics by subunit and face (6VBV)",fontsize=9); ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("\nBBS9 share of total molecular surface points: "
      f"{(T['sub']=='BBS9').mean()*100:.1f}%; of membrane-proximal quartile: "
      f"{(T[T.memface]['sub']=='BBS9').mean()*100:.1f}%")
print("negative regions, BBS9 lining residues:", [p["comp"].get("BBS9",0) for p in NEG], "of", [p["nlin"] for p in NEG])
print("positive regions, BBS9 lining residues:", [p["comp"].get("BBS9",0) for p in POS], "of", [p["nlin"] for p in POS])
print("region centres (dist-to-COM A): neg", [round(p['dcom'],1) for p in NEG], " pos", [round(p['dcom'],1) for p in POS])
